svg.text: • One user can offer many rides (1:N)
• Each ride is offered by exactly one driver
• One user can make many bookings (1:N)
• Each booking belongs to exactly one passenger
• One ride can have many bookings (1:N)
• Each booking is for exactly one ride
• One ride can have many location updates (1:N)
• Each location belongs to exactly one ride
• One user can share many locations (1:N)
• Each location is shared by exactly one user
• One user can send many messages (1:N)
• One user can receive many messages (1:N)
• Each message has one sender and one receiver
• One ride can contain many messages (1:N)
• One user can give many ratings (1:N)
• One user can receive many ratings (1:N)
• Each rating has one rater and one rated user
• One ride can have many ratings (1:N)
• Each rating is for exactly one ride
• One user can trigger many SOS alerts (1:N)
• Each SOS alert is triggered by exactly one user
• One ride can have many SOS alerts (1:N)
• Each SOS alert is for exactly one ride
